camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the network traffic data of accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData查询域名的网络流量监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-traffic-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

To specify multiple accelerated domain names, separate them with commas (,). If you do not set this parameter, data for all your accelerated domain names is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需晚于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for the query. Unit: seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported value varies based on the maximum time range per query. For more information, see the supported time granularities in the Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the carrier.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to obtain the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to obtain the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between two consecutive data records. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
